title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十五章、追杀

    冷宫大火的那晚，身受重伤的李妃让楚珠和马超把孩子送出宫去。皇帝很关心，他问：“孩子送出宫了吗？”但楚珠太难过了，说不出话来。
    包拯开口为楚珠回答了皇帝的问题：“孩子送出宫了，但在出宫门时被一个叫高小山的侍卫发现了。高小山很善良，他放了楚珠和马超。张怀为了追查楚珠和马超，杀了高小山。楚珠和马超出宫后，带着孩子一路向南跑，但最后还是被张怀追上了。”
    “张怀杀了他们吗？”皇帝又忍不住问，太后却像是已经知道了答案，脸上露出一丝冷笑。张怀跪倒在地，大喊道：“皇上，我没有！我没有杀他们！”
    “是你杀了马超！为了躲避你的追杀，他才跳江的！我亲眼看到的！”楚珠悲愤地说。
    “楚珠，你和马超出宫后发生的事情，请详细说出来。”包拯说。
    楚珠深深地吸了一口气，说：“我和马超抱着孩子往南跑，发现一路上都有人拦查，我们知道那是刘妃的人。他们应该已经发现孩子不见了，他们想把孩子抢回去杀掉。我们把孩子藏在一个食盒里，马超……”
    “食盒？”皇帝突然站了起来，吃惊的目光望向了八王爷。
    八王爷弯腰道：“皇上，请先听楚珠说完。”
    楚珠向皇上弯了弯腰，继续说道：“我们不敢走大路，一直走小路，但还是被张怀和他的人追上了。为了孩子的安全，我主动跑出来引开追兵，马超抱着孩子往另一条路跑。分开前我们说好，等安全后再去江边见面。追兵很多，我跑得很快，他们没有追到我。等没有人跟着了，我马上去了江边，但还没到就远远地看到马超正被张怀和他的人追赶。他们应该追了很久了，因为我看到马超的时候，他已经很累了。食盒不见了，他把孩子紧紧地抱在怀里，越跑越慢，后来跑不动了。就在快被抓到的时候，马超抱着孩子往江里跳了。江水很急，他和孩子立刻就被江水冲走了。那是冬天，天寒地冻的冬天，跳江一定会死啊！张怀和他的人走了，我跑到江边大哭，真想跟着也跳下去，但想到娘娘太可怜了，我不能留她一个人。就算死，我也应该死在娘娘身边。”
    “你又回宫了吗？你是怎么进宫门的？没有人发现吗？”包拯问。
    楚珠摇头说：“回来的时候，冷宫的大火还没有烧完，侍卫营从宫外找了运水车队来救火。我躲进一辆水车的水桶里，跟着水车进了宫。当时宫门口很混乱，很多值守的侍卫都被叫去救火了。没有人检查水车，我没有被发现。”
fullText.traditional:
第三十五章、追殺

    冷宮大火的那晚，身受重傷的李妃讓楚珠和馬超把孩子送出宮去。皇帝很關心，他問：“孩子送出宮了嗎？”但楚珠太難過了，說不出話來。
    包拯開口為楚珠回答了皇帝的問題：“孩子送出宮了，但在出宮門時被一個叫高小山的侍衛發現了。高小山很善良，他放了楚珠和馬超。張懷為了追查楚珠和馬超，殺了高小山。楚珠和馬超出宮後，帶著孩子一路向南跑，但最後還是被張懷追上了。”
    “張懷殺了他們嗎？”皇帝又忍不住問，太后卻像是已經知道了答案，臉上露出一絲冷笑。張懷跪倒在地，大喊道：“皇上，我沒有！我沒有殺他們！”
    “是你殺了馬超！為了躲避你的追殺，他才跳江的！我親眼看到的！”楚珠悲憤地說。
    “楚珠，你和馬超出宮後發生的事情，請詳細說出來。”包拯說。
    楚珠深深地吸了一口氣，說：“我和馬超抱著孩子往南跑，發現一路上都有人攔查，我們知道那是劉妃的人。他們應該已經發現孩子不見了，他們想把孩子搶回去殺掉。我們把孩子藏在一個食盒裡，馬超……”
    “食盒？”皇帝突然站了起來，吃驚的目光望向了八王爺。
    八王爺彎腰道：“皇上，請先聽楚珠說完。”
    楚珠向皇上彎了彎腰，繼續說道：“我們不敢走大路，一直走小路，但還是被張懷和他的人追上了。為了孩子的安全，我主動跑出來引開追兵，馬超抱著孩子往另一條路跑。分開前我們說好，等安全後再去江邊見面。追兵很多，我跑得很快，他們沒有追到我。等沒有人跟著了，我馬上去了江邊，但還沒到就遠遠地看到馬超正被張懷和他的人追趕。他們應該追了很久了，因為我看到馬超的時候，他已經很累了。食盒不見了，他把孩子緊緊地抱在懷裡，越跑越慢，後來跑不動了。就在快被抓到的時候，馬超抱著孩子往江裡跳了。江水很急，他和孩子立刻就被江水沖走了。那是冬天，天寒地凍的冬天，跳江一定會死啊！張懷和他的人走了，我跑到江邊大哭，真想跟著也跳下去，但想到娘娘太可憐了，我不能留她一個人。就算死，我也應該死在娘娘身邊。”
    “你又回宮了嗎？你是怎麼進宮門的？沒有人發現嗎？”包拯問。
    楚珠搖頭說：“回來的時候，冷宮的大火還沒有燒完，侍衛營從宮外找了運水車隊來救火。我躲進一輛水車的水桶裡，跟著水車進了宮。當時宮門口很混亂，很多值守的侍衛都被叫去救火了。沒有人檢查水車，我沒有被發現。”

sentences.traditional: 那是冬天，天寒地凍的冬天，跳江一定會死啊！
sentences.pinyin: nà shì dōng tiān tiān hán dì dòng de dōng tiān tiào jiāng yí dìng huì sǐ a
sentences.english: It was winter, a bitterly cold winter. Jumping into the river would surely mean death!

sentences.simplified: 张怀和他的人走了，我跑到江边大哭，
sentences.traditional: 張懷和他的人走了，我跑到江邊大哭，
sentences.pinyin: zhāng huái hé tā de rén zǒu le wǒ pǎo dào jiāng biān dà kū
sentences.english: Zhang Huai and his men left. I ran to the riverbank, crying loudly.

sentences.simplified: 真想跟着也跳下去，但想到娘娘太可怜了，我不能留她一个人。
sentences.traditional: 真想跟著也跳下去，但想到娘娘太可憐了，我不能留她一個人。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn xiǎng gēn zhe yě tiào xià qù dàn xiǎng dào niáng niang tài kě lián le wǒ bù néng liú tā yí ge rén
sentences.english: I really wanted to jump in after them, but then I thought of how pitiful the noble consort was. I couldn’t leave her alone.

sentences.simplified: 就算死，我也应该死在娘娘身边。”
sentences.traditional: 就算死，我也應該死在娘娘身邊。”
sentences.pinyin: jiù suàn sǐ wǒ yě yīng gāi sǐ zài niáng niang shēn biān
sentences.english: Even if I were to die, I should die by the noble consort’s side.”

sentences.simplified: “你又回宫了吗？你是怎么进宫门的？没有人发现吗？”包拯问。
sentences.traditional: “你又回宮了嗎？你是怎麼進宮門的？沒有人發現嗎？”包拯問。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yòu huí gōng le ma nǐ shì zěn me jìn gōng mén de méi yǒu rén fā xiàn ma bāo zhěng wèn
sentences.english: “Did you return to the palace again? How did you enter the palace gate? Didn’t anyone notice?” Bao Zheng asked.

sentences.simplified: 楚珠摇头说：“回来的时候，冷宫的大火还没有烧完，
sentences.traditional: 楚珠搖頭說：“回來的時候，冷宮的大火還沒有燒完，
sentences.pinyin: chǔ zhū yáo tóu shuō huí lái de shí hou lěng gōng de dà huǒ hái méi yǒu shāo wán
sentences.english: Chu Zhu shook her head and said, “When I returned, the great fire in the Cold Palace was not yet extinguished.

sentences.simplified: 侍卫营从宫外找了运水车队来救火。
sentences.traditional: 侍衛營從宮外找了運水車隊來救火。
sentences.pinyin: shì wèi yíng cóng gōng wài zhǎo le yùn shuǐ chē duì lái jiù huǒ
sentences.english: The guard camp had brought in a convoy of water carts from outside the palace to put out the fire.

sentences.simplified: 我躲进一辆水车的水桶里，跟着水车进了宫。
sentences.traditional: 我躲進一輛水車的水桶裡，跟著水車進了宮。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duǒ jìn yí liàng shuǐ chē de shuǐ tǒng lǐ gēn zhe shuǐ chē jìn le gōng
sentences.english: I hid in the barrel of a water cart and entered the palace with the water cart.

sentences.simplified: 当时宫门口很混乱，很多值守的侍卫都被叫去救火了。
sentences.traditional: 當時宮門口很混亂，很多值守的侍衛都被叫去救火了。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí gōng mén kǒu hěn hùn luàn hěn duō zhí shǒu de shì wèi dōu bèi jiào qù jiù huǒ le
sentences.english: It was very chaotic at the palace gate at that time, as many of the guards on duty had been called away to help put out the fire.

sentences.simplified: 没有人检查水车，我没有被发现。”
sentences.traditional: 沒有人檢查水車，我沒有被發現。”
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén jiǎn chá shuǐ chē wǒ méi yǒu bèi fā xiàn
sentences.english: No one checked the water cart, and I was not discovered.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 35: Pursuit
On the night of the great fire in the Cold Palace, ..
.. the seriously injured Consort Li asked Chu Zhu and Ma Chao to take the child out of the palace.
The emperor was very concerned and asked, “Was the child sent out of the palace?” However, Chu Zhu was too upset to speak.
Bao Zheng answered the emperor’s question on behalf of Chu Zhu:
“The child was taken out of the palace but was discovered by a guard named Gao Xiaoshan at the palace gate.
Gao Xiaoshan was very kind-hearted, and he let Chu Zhu and Ma Chao go.
Zhang Huai killed Gao Xiaoshan in order to track down Chu Zhu and Ma Chao.
After Chu Zhu and Ma Chao left the palace, they ran south with the child. But in the end, Zhang Huai still caught up to them.”
“Did Zhang Huai kill them?” the emperor couldn’t help but ask again.
The empress dowager, however, seemed to already know the answer, and a faint cold smile appeared on her face.
Zhang Huai fell to his knees and shouted, “Your Majesty, I did not! I did not kill them!”
“You killed Ma Chao! He only jumped into the river to escape your pursuit!  I saw it with my own eyes!”
Chu Zhu said with grief and indignation.
“Chu Zhu, please describe in detail what happened after you and Ma Chao left the palace,” Bao Zheng said.
Chu Zhu took a deep breath and said, ..
.. Ma Chao and I ran south with the child in our arms, only to find people stopping and checking us all along the way.
We knew they were Consort Liu’s people.
They must have already discovered that the child was missing, and they wanted to take the child back and kill him.
We hid the child in a food box, and Ma Chao …”
“Food box?” The emperor suddenly stood up, and his astonished gaze turned towards the Eighth Prince.
The Eighth Prince bowed and said, “Your Majesty, please let Chu Zhu finish speaking first.”
Chu Zhu bowed to the emperor and continued, “We didn’t dare to take the main road and kept to the small paths.
However, Zhang Huai and his men still caught up with us.
For the safety of the child, I took the initiative to run out and divert the pursuers, ..
.. while Ma Chao ran in another direction with the child.
Before we separated, we agreed to meet by the river once it was safe.
There were many pursuers. I ran very fast, and they didn’t catch me.
As soon as no one was following me anymore, I immediately went to the riverbank.
But before I got there, I saw from a distance that Ma Chao was being chased by Zhang Huai and his men.
They must have been chasing him for a long time because when I saw Ma Chao, he was already very tired.
The food box was gone.
He held the child tightly in his arms, running slower and slower, until he could not run anymore.
Just as he was about to be caught, Ma Chao jumped into the river with the child in his arms.
The river current was very rapid, and he and the child were immediately swept away by the river.
It was winter, a bitterly cold winter. Jumping into the river would surely mean death!
Zhang Huai and his men left. I ran to the riverbank, crying loudly.
I really wanted to jump in after them, but then I thought of how pitiful the noble consort was. I couldn’t leave her alone.
Even if I were to die, I should die by the noble consort’s side.”
“Did you return to the palace again? How did you enter the palace gate? Didn’t anyone notice?” Bao Zheng asked.
Chu Zhu shook her head and said, “When I returned, the great fire in the Cold Palace was not yet extinguished.
The guard camp had brought in a convoy of water carts from outside the palace to put out the fire.
I hid in the barrel of a water cart and entered the palace with the water cart.
It was very chaotic at the palace gate at that time, as many of the guards on duty had been called away to help put out the fire.
No one checked the water cart, and I was not discovered.”
